info.name: Insta Midnight
info.description: A premium Instagram dark theme featuring elegant purple neon accents, modern glassmorphism, smooth rounded cards, and a clean interface. Designed for a stylish, distraction-free browsing experience.
info.additionalInfo:
Theme: Insta Midnight
Version: 1.0
Compatibility: Instagram Web (Desktop)
Style: Premium Dark + Purple Neon
Features:
- AMOLED-inspired dark background
- Purple neon accents
- Modern rounded UI
- Clean typography
- Subtle glassmorphism
- Minimal visual design

Note: Visual customization only. Does not change Instagram functionality.
